handoff_instructions: ChatGPT approved: Looks good. The Twilio SMS adapter is confined to packages/integrations, uses fetch with Basic auth against the Messages API, maps Twilio statuses to domain statuses, implements idempotency keyed by organizationId + idempotencyKey, and fail-closed signature verification with constant-time compare. Webhook ingestion normalizes payload and validates identifier. Tests cover request shape/auth/body, status mapping, idempotency (including cross-org), non-2xx handling, signature verification (valid/tampered/missing), and webhook ingestion. No multi-tenant or auth leaks, no secrets exposed, and only integration adapter code was touched. Nice job. Potential future enhancement (non-blocking): consider mapping additional Twilio statuses (scheduled/canceled/receiving) as needed by domain semantics.. M2-T15 is done. Next: M2-T16 "Voice adapter (Vapi)".
